reason: The report's 2.23 comes from an unadjusted regression, but supplier_diversity is strongly correlated with pre-period firm size (0.31), export experience and prior export growth. Adding the 2020 controls cuts the coefficient to about 0.69 (SE 0.24), so the headline estimate is inflated roughly threefold by confounding. The report also trims the outcome and ran only one specification, and it doesn't discuss confounding.
